nodes.label: Phoenix.Endpoint.Supervisor init/1
nodes.desc: Assembles the endpoint supervision tree: config child, warmup, PubSub, socket children, server children, drainers, watchers.

nodes.label: Cowboy2Adapter child_specs
nodes.desc: Web-server adapter started as children; Cowboy2 is the default adapter, generated apps use Bandit.

nodes.label: Endpoint call/2
nodes.desc: Generated call/2 sets script_name, secret_key_base and the :phoenix_endpoint private key, then runs the Plug.Builder chain with error wrapping.

nodes.label: socket_dispatch/2
nodes.desc: First plug in the endpoint chain; matches conn.path_info against each socket path and dispatches to its transport plug.

nodes.label: Router call/2
nodes.desc: Prepares the conn, URI-decodes path segments and calls __match_route__(method, decoded, host).

nodes.label: __match_route__/3
nodes.desc: Pattern-match clauses compiled at build time, one function clause per route, returning metadata, prepare, a pipe chain and dispatch.

nodes.label: Route.prepare/3
nodes.desc: Shared function merging path_params, private and assigns; each route passes compile-time data instead of its own closure.

nodes.label: Router __call__/5
nodes.desc: Emits [:phoenix, :router_dispatch] telemetry, runs the compiled pipe function, then invokes the matched plug.

nodes.label: Compiled pipe function
nodes.desc: Each pipe-group declaration is compiled through Plug.Builder.compile into a named zero-arg function that transforms the conn.

nodes.label: plug.call(conn, opts)
nodes.desc: After the pipe chain, the matched plug (controller, LiveView or forwarded router) receives the piped conn.

nodes.label: Transports.WebSocket call/2
nodes.desc: GET requests on a socket path are upgraded to WebSocket via WebSockAdapter, running code reload, transport log and origin checks first.

nodes.label: Channel.Server (GenServer per channel)
nodes.desc: Each joined topic spawns a channel process under Phoenix.Socket.PoolSupervisor; handle_info dispatches handle_in/3.

edges.label: adapter process invokes the endpoint plug
router is the final plug the app declares
upgraded socket spawns channels on join
match clause returns metadata, prepare, chain, dispatch
